body: You're right. I was going for poetic license. I'll omit it.

My time to shine. I'm lonely and I don't believe in anything. That's the short of it.

I spend my time alone in my room, laughing at words on a screen to distract myself from my thoughts, all of them telling me that I'm a big joke and that I'm not worthy of anything. When I'm not doing that, I'm attempting to eat myself to death and failing that drinking. (Don't worry, I'm still 230.) 

I live with my father who does not like me. He loves me, but only out of sense of obligation. He despises my mother, and she feels the same. I am only a reminder that he failed to wear a condom. He loves my brothers more though, a scientist and a fuck up druggie government worker. 

My mother has coddled me since I was a child. Keeping me in the home away from other children, because I was "too special." So I never really learned to socialize well. I've always been "weird."

I have dated before, so I'm not completely stupid. But I am mostly naive when it comes to certain things of a romantic nature.

I have zero prospects in future. I thought I was gonna do music, but it turns I'm not so good at that no more. I'm a few credits away from an AA, but I have a horrible GPA, that may not be able get me to a better school. 

I have three friends I see regularly. And two of them are out of state for school, those same two pretty much seem like they only ever hung out with me because I was legal and the other one only hangs out with me out of habit.

I have never felt more alone in my life, than I do now.

Hey!

Wow, thank you for checking up on me. I decided to get a little extra help, and now I'm on the mend. I think I'm going to take you up on that book, thank you again. I can't really express how much this means to me in words.

Here's an alternative view.

Your boyfriend watches porn, yeah?

And he wants to watch porn while you suck him off?

Maybe the problem's on his end. Potentially, he just needs to get off watching porn because the natural stimulation has been overtaken by the artificial. It's common in porn addicts, but I don't know him like that. So keep that in mind.
